s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive dyspnea and joint pain in a patient with a history of rheumatic heart disease
salient_findings: Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and positive C-reactive protein
key_facts: 36-year-old woman with rheumatic mitral stenosis
Status post mitral valvotomy and two valve repairs
Received streptokinase for suspected prosthetic mitral valve thrombosis two weeks earlier
Experienced fever and bilateral knee pain over the past 3 days
No photosensitivity, rashes, myalgia, malaise, or lymphadenopathy
Hemoglobin 9.65 g/dL
Neutrophils 41%, lymphocytes 43%, platelets 4,456,000/µL
Prothrombin time 32.8 s, INR 2.5
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and positive C-reactive protein
Blood and urine cultures were sterile
Serologic tests for hepatitis B surface antigen, antinuclear antibody, anti–cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody, and lactate dehydrogenase were negative

shortlist.label: Infective Endocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent history of prosthetic valve and symptoms of fever and joint pain

shortlist.label: Rheumatic Fever
shortlist.why_kept: History of rheumatic mitral stenosis and symptoms of fever and joint pain

shortlist.label: Prosthetic Valve Thrombosis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent streptokinase treatment for suspected prosthetic mitral valve thrombosis

shortlist.label: Antiphospholipid Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated INR and history of valve repairs

shortlist.label: Poststreptococcal Reactive Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent streptokinase treatment and symptoms of joint pain

raw.rationale: The patient's recent history of streptokinase treatment for suspected prosthetic mitral valve thrombosis and the development of fever and bilateral knee pain without other systemic symptoms are consistent with poststreptococcal reactive arthritis, especially given the lack of evidence for infection or other autoimmune conditions.

rejected.label: Rheumatic Fever
rejected.why: Lack of migratory polyarthritis, subcutaneous nodules, and other major criteria

rejected.label: Prosthetic Valve Thrombosis
rejected.why: Recent treatment with streptokinase and no clear evidence of current thrombosis

rejected.label: Antiphospholipid Syndrome
rejected.why: No evidence of thrombosis or positive serologic tests for antiphospholipid antibodies
